title: Oven Roasted Japanese Udon Noodles
description: A creamy and floral one-pot dish featuring udon noodles in a mother-sauce-base, cooked to perfection in a tagine pot. This Whole30-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional Polish cuisine with Japanese flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large tagine pot, combine the udon noodles, coconut milk, bone broth, sesame oil, grated ginger, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Stir well to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
Cover the tagine pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the noodles in the oven for 25 minutes or until they are cooked through and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the tagine pot from the oven and stir in the chopped scallions.
Let the dish cool for a few minutes before serving.
Garnish with additional scallions if desired.
